name: Wild Shape
uses: 2 per short or long rest (unlimited at level 20)
description: Action: turn into a beast you have seen, within the Max CR and limits for your level. You can stay in the form for hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down), then revert unless you spend another use. A bonus action ends it early; dropping to 0 HP also ends it and spare damage carries over to your normal form.

You use the beast's stats and HP but keep your mental scores, alignment and proficiencies (take the better bonus). You can't cast spells, though a spell already running stays on. Gear falls off, merges or is worn, your choice.
Level 18: you can cast druid spells in beast form with verbal and somatic components only. Level 20: unlimited uses.

name: Arctic
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: hold person, spike growth. Druid level 5: sleet storm, slow. Druid level 7: freedom of movement, ice storm. Druid level 9: commune with nature, cone of cold.

name: Coast
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: mirror image, misty step. Druid level 5: water breathing, water walk. Druid level 7: control water, freedom of movement. Druid level 9: conjure elemental, scrying.

name: Natural Recovery
description: Meditate during a short rest to get back spent spell slots. Add up the slot levels you recover: the total may not top half your druid level (round up), and no single slot can be 6th level or more.
For example, at druid level 4 you could get back one 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

name: Combat Wild Shape
resource: Wild Shape use, or a spell slot to heal
description: Enter Wild Shape as a bonus action instead of an action.
While in a beast form, you can also spend a bonus action and 1 spell slot to heal 1d8 hit points per level of the slot.

name: Circle Forms
description: Raises the toughest beast Wild Shape can turn you into. Disregard the Max. CR figure in the Beast Shapes table; every other limit there still holds.
The ceiling is challenge rating 1 at levels 2 to 5, then from level 6 it is one third of your druid level, dropping any remainder.

name: Elemental Wild Shape
description: Spend 2 uses of Wild Shape at once to turn into an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

name: Thousand Forms
description: You can cast alter self whenever you like, with no spell slot.

name: Desert
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: blur, silence. Druid level 5: create food and water, protection from energy. Druid level 7: blight, hallucinatory terrain. Druid level 9: insect plague, wall of stone.

name: Forest
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: barkskin, spider climb. Druid level 5: call lightning, plant growth. Druid level 7: divination, freedom of movement. Druid level 9: commune with nature, tree stride.

name: Grassland
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: invisibility, pass without trace. Druid level 5: daylight, haste. Druid level 7: divination, freedom of movement. Druid level 9: dream, insect plague.

name: Mountain
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: spider climb, spike growth. Druid level 5: lightning bolt, meld into stone. Druid level 7: stone shape, stoneskin. Druid level 9: passwall, wall of stone.

name: Swamp
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: darkness, Melf's acid arrow. Druid level 5: water walk, stinking cloud. Druid level 7: freedom of movement, locate creature. Druid level 9: insect plague, scrying.

name: Underdark
description: Pick this land as your circle's home and gain its circle spells. They are always prepared and do not count against your daily prepared limit. Druid level 3: spider climb, web. Druid level 5: gaseous form, stinking cloud. Druid level 7: greater invisibility, stone shape. Druid level 9: cloudkill, insect plague.

name: Halo of Spores
trigger: A creature you can see moves within 10 ft of you or starts its turn there
description: Use your reaction to unleash your invisible spores on it: it takes 1d4 necrotic damage unless it passes a Constitution save against your spell save DC.
The die grows to 1d6 at druid level 6, 1d8 at level 10 and 1d10 at level 14.

name: Symbiotic Entity
description: Action: spend a Wild Shape use to wake your spores instead of taking a beast shape. You gain 4 temporary hit points per druid level, and while it lasts:
• Your Halo of Spores rolls its damage die twice and adds both.
• Each hit with a melee weapon attack adds 1d6 necrotic damage.
It lasts 10 minutes, or until those temporary hit points are gone or you use Wild Shape again.

name: Fungal Infestation
trigger: A Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 ft of you
description: Use your reaction to make the corpse rise at once with 1 hit point. Uses the zombie stats (Monster Manual). After 1 hour it collapses and dies.
In combat it acts right after you, obeys your mental commands, and its only possible action is Attack, with one melee attack.

name: Spreading Spores
description: Bonus action: hurl spores to a point up to 30 ft away, where they fill a 10-ft cube for 1 minute. They vanish early if you use this again, dismiss them with a bonus action, or Symbiotic Entity ends.
A creature that enters the cube or starts its turn in it takes your Halo of Spores damage unless it passes a Constitution save against your spell save DC; no creature takes it more than once a turn.
Your Halo of Spores reaction is unavailable while the cube exists.

name: Star Map
uses: Proficiency bonus free casts per long rest

spells.uses: Free casts: proficiency bonus per long rest

description: You own a Tiny star chart (pick its look or roll on the Star Map table) that can be your spellcasting focus for druid spells.

While you hold it, you know guidance, and guiding bolt is always prepared without counting against your prepared spells. You can also cast that guiding bolt with no spell slot, as many times as your proficiency bonus, regaining them after a long rest.
If the map is lost, a 1-hour ceremony, which you can do during a short or long rest, makes a new one and destroys the old.

name: Starry Form
description: Bonus action: spend a Wild Shape use to take a starry form instead of a beast shape. You keep your statistics and shed bright light in 10 ft and dim light 10 ft beyond. It lasts 10 minutes, ending early if you dismiss it (no action), are incapacitated, die, or use this feature again.
Each time you take the form, choose which constellation shines on you:

Archer: as you take the form, and with a bonus action on later turns while it lasts, make a ranged spell attack at one creature within 60 ft. On a hit it takes 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier radiant damage.
Chalice: whenever you cast a spell with a spell slot that heals someone, you or another creature within 30 ft of you also regains 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier hit points.
Dragon: on Intelligence or Wisdom checks, and on Constitution saves to keep concentration, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

Level 10 (Twinkling Constellations): the Archer and Chalice dice become 2d8, the Dragon also gives you a 20-ft flying speed and hover, and as each of your turns begins in the form you may switch constellation.
Level 14 (Full of Stars): in the form you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

name: Cosmic Omen
trigger: A creature you can see within 30 ft is about to make an attack roll, save or ability check
description: After each long rest, consult your Star Map and roll any die. Until your next long rest, its result sets which reaction you have:
Weal (even): roll a d6 and add it to that creature's roll.
Woe (odd): roll a d6 and take it off that creature's roll.
